title: CRA evidence refresh status
description: refresh-status.json in the CRA output directory (CW_CRA_OUT), written atomically by cra/refresh.mjs on every exit path, the failed preflight gate's included, and read by cra/evidence-status.mjs. It records how the last refresh ended; the evidence index beside it records what the refresh produced.

exit.description: The run's exit: the worst step exit, or the preflight gate's when it stopped the run.

ok.description: False when any step failed. A watch signal or a skipped optional step does not make it false.

reason.description: Why the run failed, naming each failed step; null when no step failed.

steps.description: The steps that ran, in order. A run the preflight gate stopped lists only the steps up to it.

reason.description: Present unless the outcome is ok.
